near_misses.claim: The spin-network states of Rovelli-Smolin are orthonormal under the Ashtekar-Lewandowski measure, as recorded in the source node.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: No cited declaration in @SRC or @KNOWN+ formalizes the loop/connection representation, the Mandelstam identities, or the Ashtekar-Lewandowski Haar measure, so the orthonormality claim cannot be grounded in the allowed Lean inventory.

near_misses.claim: The SU(2) spin-network vertex amplitude of the discrete spin connection module can be identified with the Rovelli-Smolin intertwiner for higher-valence vertices.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The available existing declarations concern tetrahedral spinfoam vertex amplitudes (Cyclo12), not higher-valence virtual trivalent trees, so no identification is grounded.

open_obligations: Ground the SU(2) Mandelstam identities (paper Section 2 eq. (21)) in a Lean declaration; none is listed in @SRC or @KNOWN+.
Formalize the imbedded-graph labelling with twice-spins p_l and the loop-to-connection basis (Sections 3-4); no existing declaration covers it.
Formalize the virtual trivalent tree / intertwiner construction at higher-valence vertices (Appendix A pp. 36-38).
Formalize the Ashtekar-Lewandowski Haar measure and the orthonormality theorem (Section 6 pp. 26-29).
The SpinConnectionError, DiscreteSpinConnection and spin_connection_antisymmetry sources in @SRC were not checked against the paper's content, so they are not cited here.
